title: Fail closed on no-video TDARR fixtures
summary: TDARR matrix audits now probe video-declared fixtures before automatic sample selection, skip no-video mismatches for automatic runs, and report fixture_probe_mismatch warnings. Backend processing now fails closed with SOURCE_MEDIA_VIDEO_MISSING before route selection when source probing finds no usable video stream.
reason: TDARR includes fixture rows whose catalog/name says video, especially MJPEG .mp2 rows, but ffprobe identifies them as audio-only media. Those rows should be treated as invalid source fixtures instead of evidence that MJPEG encode policy failed.
manual_validation: Explicit media-policy run passed tdarr-1223:tv MJPEG encode fallback and tdarr-1183:tv remux regression with zero findings
TDARR 6-file smoke selected valid MJPEG tdarr-1223:tv and reported tdarr-1222:tv fixture_probe_mismatch
behavior_before: Automatic TDARR smoke selection could pick video-labeled fixtures whose probed streams had no usable video, causing misleading MJPEG/audio-only processing failures. Backend processing could continue past a video_stream_missing source probe into route selection and FFmpeg/remux handling.
behavior_after: Automatic TDARR smoke selection probes candidate video-declared rows and backfills when a candidate has no usable video. Explicit case-key runs still run but record fixture_probe_mismatch. Backend processing records a permanent non-retryable SOURCE_MEDIA_VIDEO_MISSING failure at source-probe before route selection or FFmpeg command launch.
rollback_plan: Revert the TDARR fixture probe filtering helpers and command wiring, remove SOURCE_MEDIA_VIDEO_MISSING from pipeline processing and failure-code metadata, and remove the added Python/PowerShell tests and generated summaries.
notes:
Implement fixture probe mismatch filtering and fail-closed no-video source handling.
Added source-probe backend unit test for SOURCE_MEDIA_VIDEO_MISSING guard.
Also registered emitted SUBTITLE_MP4_EXTERNAL_SRT_REQUIRED outcome metadata discovered by registry validation.
Added refreshed pipeline_processing summary generated after source-probe guard edit.
Implementation and targeted validation complete; strict coverage is blocked by unrelated packets/files reported separately.
